# Source: Flower Girl in Holland

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** Flower Girl in Holland
- **Artist / culture:** George Hitchcock American, 1850–1913
- **Date:** 1887
- **Style:** Impressionism
- **Classification:** painting
- **Department:** Arts of the Americas
- **AIC artwork ID:** 138
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/138
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/e72305c9-1a1c-8a36-7450-582619366338/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Impressionism

## Extracted source palette

`#485848, #686858, #887868, #383838, #989888, #B8A888, #C8E8E8, #B8C8B8`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#1D1D1D`
- `surface`: `#373737`
- `on_surface`: `#F8F8F6`
- `primary`: `#B8A888`
- `on_primary`: `#0C0C0E`
- `secondary`: `#C8E8E8`
- `surface_variant`: `#373737`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#F8F8F6`
- `outline`: `#5A5A5A`
- `error`: `#B8A888`
- `on_error`: `#0C0C0E`

- Font: `serif` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `12dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `15.85:1`, surface `11.2:1`
- Variant contrast: `11.2:1`
- Control contrast: `8.37:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
